title: Students above the class average
statementMd:
List students whose average score exceeds the average of all scores. Show name and average rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `name`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare `AVG(score)` per student with a scalar subquery.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT s.name, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 1) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING AVG(e.score) > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM enrollments);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
